annotations.title: Get the project's effective billing terms

description:
Get the project's effective billing terms

Returns what the selected project is billed on now, per category it holds: the plan as its subscription has it, with any override applied, each fixed charge at the subscription's price and quantity, and resolved entitlements; where the plan comes from; how invoices are paid; the current period and next billing date; and any downgrade or cancellation waiting for the period end. Supply both organizationId and projectId; the organization must pay for the project. This operation does not change billing.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/organization-billing/get-the-projects-effective-billing-terms
name: getEffectiveTerms

baseAmountCents.description: Recurring base price in whole cents.

categoryDisplayName.description: Display name for the subscription category; absent or null when unconfigured.

isDefault.description: The category's default plan: the one a project holds when it pays for none, and moves to at the period end when it leaves a paid plan. At most one per category.

tier.description: Rank within the category: moving to a higher tier is an upgrade and applies now, to a lower one a downgrade scheduled for the period end. Null when the plan has none.

tierDisplayName.description: The plan's tier as customers see it, e.g. Pro for Messaging Pro, where the category is already clear. Null when unconfigured.

subscriptions.description: One entry per category the project holds, by category. Empty means it holds none.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone the payer is billed in, e.g. America/Los_Angeles. Billing periods start and end at its midnights, so read their calendar dates in it.

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description:
Enum descriptions: {"automatic":"Charged to the payer's payment method when issued.","manual":"Paid outside the payment provider."}

Known values: ["automatic","manual"]. Others may be added.

Enum descriptions: {"catalog":"A plan published in the catalog, unchanged.","override":"Terms of its own: a plan override on the subscription, or a plan outside the published catalog."}

Known values: ["catalog","override"]. Others may be added.
A coupon discounting the subscription now, as a Stripe Discount.

amountCents.description: Amount off in cents of currency: each period when repeating or forever, once when once. Null for a percentage.

appliesTo.description: The fees it discounts: those of any listed kind or fixed charge. Null when it discounts every fee in its scope.

endsAt.description: When it stops discounting, exclusive, ISO 8601: the last discounted day is the day before, in timeZone. Null for once and forever.

organizationWide.description: Applied to the paying organization rather than one project: it discounts every subscription the organization pays for, and a fixed amount is one allowance shared across them.

promotionCode.description: The promotion code it was redeemed with, or null when operations applied it.

rate.description: Percentage off as a decimal, e.g. "50" for half off. Null for an amount.

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: What one subscription is billed on now. plan is the plan as this subscription has it: its own prices when overridden, each fixed charge at the subscription's price and quantity, and entitlements resolved with overrides.

cancelsAt.description: When the subscription ends instead of renewing, ISO 8601.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. analytics or messaging.

coupons.description: The coupons in effect, oldest redemption first. A project's are its own; the organization's also carry those applied to the organization.

nextBillingAt.description: When the next invoice is issued: the second after the period ends, ISO 8601.

scheduledPlanChange.description: A downgrade waiting for the period end, or null.
